name: Mio
source:
Mio is the daughter of an extremely wealthy businessman in Star Cove. Excelling in both sports and academics, she is the very definition of a “honor student”. There are even rumours of her [url=/c126655]father[/url] asking her for advice on his business. Despite that, she gets along well with her peers and is generally well regarded by them.
